terminal_condition.meaning: All URLs in this currently exposed sitemap were consumed; this does not establish complete publication history.

deduplication.key: Official canonical URL with query/fragment removed and trailing slash normalized; matching records link all previous .md/.json files.
deduplication.prior_record_scan: Every 103 .md/.json file below docs/research/engineering-toolkit, excluding the concurrent 2026-10-01 run.

exclusions: 786 tag/topic URLs; publication root and About page.
Article prose, diagrams, code, comments, and linked resources. No new deep-read claim.
Deleted/private/inaccessible stories and historical URLs not exposed by the current sitemap.
gaps: The sitemap only exposes 219 articles; earliest verified publication date is 2020-10-19. Pre-2020 coverage remains unresolved.

Direct archive/all HTTP probes return 403. Web extraction of /archive and /archive/2020 shows filters but no story listing or usable pagination, so historical traversal cannot establish a terminal archive.
RSS exposes only the latest ten articles with no older-page cursor; exhausting that feed is not exhausting the archive.
Sitemap lastmod values are retained as modification metadata and never substituted for publication dates.
Web extraction does not expose HTTP status. Current pages may be cached; title/date verification records the observed primary page, not a live HTTP 200 assertion.

request_policy.archive_requests: Sequential per hostname; independent publisher hostnames may run concurrently.
request_policy.web_header_requests: Sequential calls with minimum 1.05 seconds between starts. Web tool controls its HTTP timeout and does not expose a numeric timeout or transport status.
request_policy.full_text_storage: None. Temporary downloaded pages were used only to extract metadata; no article bodies retained in these deliverables.

endpoints.observed_result: Year filter visible; no article listing

header_requests.additional_note: The first article was opened once for feasibility before the full pass; the ads header required a second standalone retry after a truncated two-page response.
